arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
s = open('/tmp/e2e.sh').read()
# openp helper with wait
s = s.replace('''ab() { AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=$_ses agent-browser "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; }''',
'''ab() { AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=$_ses agent-browser "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
openp() { ab open "$1"; sleep 1.0; }''')
s = s.replace('ab open "', 'openp "')
# signin: click the button named Sign in, not the link
s = s.replace('''  fill_name "Password" "Valid-password-123!"
  click_name "Sign in"
  sleep 0.6''',
'''  fill_name "Password" "Valid-password-123!"
  local r; r=$(snap | grep -E 'button[^"]*"Sign in"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*\\[ref=(e[0-9]+)\\].*/@\\1/')
  ab click "$r"
  sleep 1.2''')
# longer sleeps after clicks
s = s.replace('sleep 0.4; }', 'sleep 0.7; }')
s = s.replace('sleep 0.5\n', 'sleep 0.8\n')
open('/tmp/e2e.sh','w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "openp\|sleep 0.4\|ab open" /tmp/e2e.sh | head -20
cd /tmp && sed -i 's|openp() { openp "$1"; sleep 1.0; }|openp() { ab open "$1"; sleep 1.0; }|' e2e.sh && sed -n '8,14p' e2e.sh

export AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=dbg3 TMPDIR=/tmp
agent-browser eval "document.body.innerText.slice(0,600)" 2>&1 | head -20
echo ===
agent-browser eval "window.__errs||'n/a'" 2>&1 | head -3
agent-browser console 2>&1 | head -20

edits.oldText: for (const c of comments) items.push({ id: `c${c.id}`, entry: 'comment', ...commentJson(db, c, userId) });
edits.newText: for (const c of comments) items.push({ ...commentJson(db, c, userId), entry: 'comment', id: `c${c.id}` });

arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
s = open('/tmp/e2e.sh').read()

# A: clear the searchbox with real keystrokes (fill "" doesn't fire onChange reliably)
s = s.replace('''click_name "Closed"
fill_name "Search issues" ""
has "Legacy welcome text"''',
'''click_name "Closed"
r=$(ref_of "Search issues"); ab click "$r"; ab press Control+a; ab press Delete; sleep 1.0
has "Legacy welcome text"''')

# C: unassign / unlabel option clicks — options render as buttons; drop 'option' filter
s = s.replace("r=$(snap | grep -F 'carol-maintainer\"' | grep -i option | grep -oE 'ref=e[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/ref=/@/')",
              "r=$(snap | grep -F 'carol-maintainer\"' | grep -E 'button|option' | grep -oE 'ref=e[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/ref=/@/')")
s = s.replace("r=$(snap | grep -F 'documentation\"' | grep -i option | grep -oE 'ref=e[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/ref=/@/')",
              "r=$(snap | grep -F 'documentation\"' | grep -E 'button|option' | grep -oE 'ref=e[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/ref=/@/')")

# F: feature-search pair already has an open PR -> dedup, creation disabled.
#    Title validation moves to the clean create-pr-source pair.
s = s.replace('''r=$(ref_of "compare"); ab select "$r" "feature-search"; sleep 1.2
has "Commit summary"
has "src/search.ts"
has "additions, "
click_name "Create pull request"
hasctl "Title"
r=$(ref_btn "Create pull request"); ab click "$r"; sleep 0.8
has "Title is required"
fill_name "Title" "E2E dup PR"
r=$(ref_btn "Create pull request"); ab click "$r"; sleep 1.2
has "A pull request for these branches already exists"
# clean pair: create
openp "$R/compare?base=main&compare=create-pr-source"
has "Commit summary"
click_name "Create pull request"
fill_name "Title" "E2E created PR"
fill_name "Description" "PR body"
r=$(ref_btn "Create pull request"); ab click "$r"; sleep 1.2
hasctl "E2E created PR"
has "Open"''',
'''r=$(ref_of "compare"); ab select "$r" "feature-search"; sleep 1.2
has "Commit summary"
has "src/search.ts"
has "additions, "
has "A pull request for these branches already exists"
[ "$(disabled_count 'Create pull request')" -ge 1 ] && echo "PASS: create disabled for dup pair" || { echo "FAIL: create enabled for dup pair"; FAILED=1; }
# clean pair: blank title rejected, then successful create
openp "$R/compare?base=main&compare=create-pr-source"
has "Commit summary"
click_name "Create pull request"
hasctl "Title"
r=$(ref_btn "Create pull request"); ab click "$r"; sleep 0.8
has "Title is required"
fill_name "Title" "E2E created PR"
fill_name "Description" "PR body"
r=$(ref_btn "Create pull request"); ab click "$r"; sleep 1.2
hasctl "E2E created PR"
has "Open"''')

# I: reviewer option grep — buttons, not options
s = s.replace("r=$(snap | grep -F '\"bob-reviewer\"' | grep -i option | grep -oE 'ref=e[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/ref=/@/')",
              "r=$(snap | grep -F '\"bob-reviewer\"' | grep -E 'button|option' | grep -oE 'ref=e[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/ref=/@/')")

open('/tmp/e2e.sh','w').write(s)
EOF
bash -n /tmp/e2e.sh && echo ok
